title: init and flow start assume an origin remote that may not exist
desc:
In a repo with no remote, wb init reports flow: source master, validation none -- read off the remote branches, and wb flow start prints git fetch origin and git switch ... origin/master, both of which fail. A printed command that cannot run is a wasted paste; with --execute it is a failed step.

ACCEPTANCE:
- init says the source was read from the local branch when there is no remote
- flow start with no origin remote refuses with a config error naming the fix (add a remote), instead of printing commands that cannot run
- doctor's flow check warns when the source's remote is missing
- tests for each
